labels.environment: Every node is a dkv-server process on the machine below, with its data on ext4; the load generator runs on the same machine. 16 shards (and the meta group).
labels.title: Durability path
labels.what: Three nodes, RF 3, writes only. The single-log path (the default: the Raft log is a replica's only write-ahead log) against the two-log path (storage.engine_wal: each replica's engine also logs and fsyncs every write), docs/adr/0010.
